analysis.summary: Users must be able to log in to SauceDemo with valid credentials to reach the inventory page; invalid or empty credentials must be rejected with error messages.

explicit_requirements.statement: Users must be able to log in to SauceDemo using valid credentials and reach the inventory page.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Users must be able to log in to SauceDemo using valid credentials and reach the inventory page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Invalid credentials and empty submissions must be rejected.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Invalid credentials and empty submissions must be rejected.

explicit_requirements.statement: Given standard_user / secret_sauce, the user is taken to the inventory page.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Given standard_user / secret_sauce, the user is taken to the inventory page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Given invalid credentials, an error message is displayed and the user stays on the login page.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Given invalid credentials, an error message is displayed and the user stays on the login page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Given empty username or password, an error message is displayed.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Given empty username or password, an error message is displayed.

scenarios.title: Login with valid credentials navigates to inventory page
Login with invalid credentials shows error and remains on login page
Login with empty username shows error
Login with empty password shows error

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Login with other valid user accounts
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Requirement mentions valid credentials but only specifies standard_user/secret_sauce; other valid users are not covered.

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Login with whitespace-only username or password
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Empty submission is defined, but handling of whitespace-only input is unclear.

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Multiple consecutive failed login attempts
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Potential lockout or throttling behavior is not described.

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Case sensitivity of username and password
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: No guidance on whether credentials are case‑sensitive.

missing_information: List of all valid user credentials
Maximum number of login attempts before lockout
ambiguities: Definition of "invalid credentials" (wrong username, wrong password, or both)
Whether "empty username or password" includes both fields being empty simultaneously
assumptions: The login page is the only entry point for authentication
analysis.validation_notes: All explicit statements are captured as requirements; derived scenarios follow directly from those requirements. No contradictions detected.
